=== OCTOPUBLISHER CLI ===

Universal multi-store deployment automation engine for OctoCore applications.

Usage: octopublish <module> <action> [options]

Available Modules:
  mstore     Microsoft Store (Windows MSIX / AppX submissions)
  playstore  Google Play Store (Android AAB / APK releases)

Global Options:
  -v, --version  Show version information
  -h, --help     Show help information

Run 'octopublish mstore --help' or 'octopublish playstore --help'.
